definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is relatively old. A polite and neutral way to refer to older people, more respectful than alternatives.

examples.japanese: {年配|ねんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{席|せき}を{譲|ゆず}る→席を譲る：16262_sekiwoyuzuru⟧。
examples.english: To give up one's seat to an elderly person.

examples.japanese: {年配|ねんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はな}しかけて→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧きた。
examples.english: An elderly man spoke to me.
This shop has many older customers.

notes:
{年配|ねんぱい} is a polite, neutral way to describe someone who is older. Often used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年配|ねんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: older person (polite)
- {年配|ねんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧: older man
- {年配|ねんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: older woman
- {年配|ねんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧: older customer
- {年配|ねんぱい}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: older person (slightly formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年配|ねんぱい}: elderly, older (polite, neutral — most versatile)
- お⟦{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧: elderly person (common, warm/respectful)
- ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧: senior citizen (formal, official/medical contexts)
- ⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧: old person (can sound blunt or clinical)

USAGE:
Generally refers to people in their 50s-70s or older. More polite than ⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧ and less formal than ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧, making it suitable for everyday conversation.
